# ferriskey_portal_layout (Resource)

Manages a login portal layout (the frame around themed pages) in a FerrisKey realm. The first layout created in a realm automatically becomes its default; use `ferriskey_portal_default_layout` to choose the default explicitly. The API refuses to delete the default layout: destroying it emits a warning and only removes it from Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_portal_layout" "frame" {
  realm = "acme"
  name  = "frame"

  tree = jsonencode({
    type     = "root"
    children = []
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Layout name.
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm the layout belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `tree` (String) Layout component tree as a JSON string, typically built with `jsonencode`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{layout_id}`.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this layout is the realm default. Read-only; see `ferriskey_portal_default_layout`.
- `layout_id` (String) Server-assigned UUID of the layout.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_portal_layout.frame acme/4b2d7f90-1111-2222-3333-444455556666
```
